程序包 org.bukkit.inventory

类 TransmuteRecipe

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.inventory.CraftingRecipe
org.bukkit.inventory.TransmuteRecipe
所有已实现的接口:
net.kyori.adventure.key.Keyed, ComplexRecipe, Recipe, Keyed
public class TransmuteRecipe extends CraftingRecipe implements ComplexRecipe
代表一种配方，当与额外材料结合时会改变输入材料的类型，但保留所有自定义数据。仅使用结果物品栈的物品类型。
在原版中用于给潜影盒染色。

原文： Represents a recipe which will change the type of the input material when combined with an additional material, but preserve all custom data. Only the item type of the result stack will be used.
Used for dyeing shulker boxes in Vanilla.
